title: 2004 HMMT February Team Problem 10
statement: Let \(a\) be an element of \(T\). Let the image of \(a\) be the set of all elements of \(T\) that can be represented as \(a \star b\) for some \(b \in T\). Prove that if \(c\) is in the image of \(a\), then \(a \star c=c\).

solutions.text: Write \(c=a \star b\), and then \(a \star c=a \star a \star b=a \star b\) (since \(a \star a=a\) ) \(=c\).
